title: 用100步GRPO微调350M模型实现更优结构化输出
summary: 本文介绍了使用GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）算法，在仅100步内对350M参数的小型语言模型进行微调，以提升其生成结构化输出（如JSON、代码等）的能力。文章基于Hugging Face的TRL库和IFStruct数据集，展示了如何通过强化学习优化模型的格式遵循能力，而无需大规模数据或超大模型。实验表明，经过100步GRPO训练后，模型在结构化输出任务上的准确率显著提升，接近甚至超越更大规模模型的表现。文章详细说明了GRPO的实现细节、训练配置、奖励函数设计以及评估方法，并讨论了该方法的效率优势、适用场景和潜在局限性。该研究为资源受限环境下提升模型结构化输出能力提供了一种高效、低成本的解决方案，对实际应用具有重要参考价值。
summary_en: This article introduces the use of GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization) to fine-tune a 350M-parameter small language model in just 100 steps, aiming to improve its capability in generating structured outputs such as JSON and code. Based on Hugging Face's TRL library and the IFStruct dataset, the authors demonstrate how reinforcement learning can enhance format-following abilities without requiring massive data or huge models. Experiments show that after 100 GRPO steps, the model's accuracy on structured output tasks significantly improves, approaching or even surpassing larger models. The article details the implementation of GRPO, training configurations, reward function design, and evaluation methods, while discussing the efficiency advantages, applicable scenarios, and potential limitations. This work provides an efficient and cost-effective solution for improving structured output generation in resource-constrained environments, offering valuable insights for practical applications.
